output.summary: A genus of wild and domesticated grasses whose wild forms were harvested in West Asia before cultivation began in the Fertile Crescent around 9600 BC. Wheat has hollow, jointed stems topped by ears of grain. Its grains are staple foods worldwide and are commonly processed into flour, bread, pasta and other foods.
output.edibilityNote: The grains are worldwide staples, commonly milled into flour or processed into bread, pasta, cereals and drinks.
